_about: CVE fix pairs that every pull request re-scores in CI (benchmarks/smoke.py, the workflow's smoke job): each was found in verdict mode and quiet after its fix in the nightly of 2026-11-28, and each must stay so. Chosen across rules and from repositories small enough to fetch quickly; never from blind suites. A rule change that moves one on purpose updates this list in the same commit and says why in docs/plan-log.md.
